parsing_rationale: The provided document is a template (placeholder-based) rather than a populated constitution. I have extracted the structural placeholders as elements to maintain the graph's integrity, mapping the generic sections to the required template fields based on the provided examples (e.g., 'Development Workflow' mapped to 'Branching & PR Workflow'). Since the content consists of placeholders, most technical rules are represented as 'requirements' for the final document.
